scripts.db:seed:users: npx tsx -e "import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'; import { seedUsers } from './prisma/src/seed-user'; const prisma = new PrismaClient(); seedUsers(prisma).then(() => prisma.$disconnect())"
scripts.db:seed:posts: npx tsx -e "import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'; import { seedPosts } from './prisma/src/seed-post'; const prisma = new PrismaClient(); prisma.user.findMany().then(users => seedPosts(prisma, users)).then(() => prisma.$disconnect())"
scripts.db:seed:follows: npx tsx -e "import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'; import { seedFollows } from './prisma/src/seed-follow'; const prisma = new PrismaClient(); prisma.user.findMany().then(users => seedFollows(prisma, users)).then(() => prisma.$disconnect())"
scripts.db:seed:likes: npx tsx -e "import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'; import { seedLikes } from './prisma/src/seed-like'; const prisma = new PrismaClient(); Promise.all([prisma.user.findMany(), prisma.post.findMany()]).then(([users, posts]) => seedLikes(prisma, users, posts)).then(() => prisma.$disconnect())"
